persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make an 8-second widescreen explainer showing a seed sprouting. Use this exact voice-over: “A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.” Simple animation, no on-screen text or music.
bank.Voice-over wording: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.
bank.Visual style: Simple animation showing the seed and its growth.
bank.Voice and language: English; voice choice is your call.
bank.Text and music: No on-screen text and no music.

messages.text: I'd like you to make an explainer showing a seed sprouting, using simple animation. I've always found that little moment when a seed starts growing really satisfying, which is why I want to see it animated. It should be 8 seconds long and widescreen, in 16:9 format. For the voice-over, use these exact words: “A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.” Please don't include any on-screen text or music.
